sanitizedScreenEvidence.inspection: The initial real creation dialog showed Smart-fill enabled despite project automation being off. It establishes the discovered manual-tutorial gap, not the corrected off state.
The member Plan tab shows 3/3, the nested work task completed, the canceled task retained and the Questions item unchecked.
The reloaded board is visible; the Done column is outside this screenshot. This image alone does not establish saved done status.
The owner sees DOC-13 in Done and the member comment. The comment is partly clipped in this viewport; its full saved body was verified through DOM/API.
The owner sees saved 3/3, all three work tasks checked, and the canceled task and Questions item unchanged.
The General section displays project name/key as static text and no Save control. Global navigation inputs are outside the asserted authorization boundary.
The owner General section contains editable project-name/key fields and a Save control; no owner setting was changed.
The anonymous documentation UI visibly includes the new Smart-fill-off manual instruction and its independence from project automation and Smart Assign.

assessment: The rendered documentation supports this actual local manual member-to-owner workflow after the Smart-fill clarification. The member saved a comment and all counted plan tasks, completed DOC-13, and the owner independently reopened the saved outcome. The member owner-only save was denied. This is agent execution evidence for this profile, not human acceptance or proof of all release platforms.
